style: White and bone-colored scratchboard engraving on a pure black background, fine hatching and cross-hatching, macabre gothic dungeon mood, high contrast, centered composition, no text, no letters, no frame, no border

emblem-key.prompt: An ornate antique iron skeleton key lying diagonally, bow shaped like a small skull, seen from above, isolated emblem filling the center

emblem-gate.prompt: A small gothic portal shaped like a screaming skull whose open mouth is an arched doorway into darkness, iron rivets at four corners, isolated emblem seen from the front

emblem-waxEater.prompt: A monster that devours candle wax: a whirling vortex of bony clawed hands and dripping melted wax around a toothy maw, seen from above, isolated circular emblem

emblem-start.prompt: A circular carved stone rune seal on the floor with a single small candle burning in its center, seen from above, isolated circular emblem

menu-bg.prompt: A vast underground labyrinth of narrow stone corridors dissolving into darkness, seen from a high angle, a few tiny candle flames held by hooded prisoners far apart, crumbling floor tiles falling into a void

victory.prompt: A massive ancient gate swinging open, warm light pouring out of it, four hooded prisoners holding candles and keys stepping through together, silhouettes

defeat.prompt: Four extinguished candles with thin smoke trails rising, the stone labyrinth around them crumbling and swallowed by darkness, clawed shadows reaching in

emblem-keyKeeper.prompt: A hunched gaunt guardian creature curled around a large antique key it clutches in its long claws, wide fanged maw, seen from above, symmetrical, isolated circular emblem

emblem-darkSpawn.prompt: A writhing knot of black tentacles bursting out of a cracked floor, four deep cracks running diagonally to the corners, seen from above, isolated circular emblem

emblem-herald.prompt: A tall hooded robed figure with no face holding a bell, ominous omen messenger, seen from the front, isolated circular emblem

emblem-inevitable.prompt: A colossal armored skeletal knight's helmet with glowing empty eye slits and a crown of spikes, seen from the front, symmetrical, isolated circular emblem

emblem-lightEater.prompt: A moth-like creature with huge dusty wings swallowing a tiny candle flame with its proboscis, seen from above, symmetrical, isolated circular emblem

emblem-pathBreaker.prompt: A massive stone fist smashing the floor, jagged cracks radiating outwards, flying rubble, seen from above, symmetrical, isolated circular emblem

mourner.prompt: A giant weeping veiled woman's face made of shadow, long tears of darkness streaming down, wide open sorrowful mouth like an abyss, seen from the front, symmetrical, fills the frame
